text: Patient started on osimertinib 80 mg daily as first-line therapy for stage IIIA EGFR-mutant lung adenocarcinoma. Baseline labs: CBC, CMP within normal limits. LFTs normal. Patient tolerated first dose well. Discussed expected side effects including diarrhea, rash, and nail changes. Scheduled for follow-up in 2 weeks to monitor tolerance and side effects. Repeat imaging planned in 6-8 weeks to assess response.
